name: Misli
verdict: Owned by Demirören Yatırım Holding, a private family holding. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Licensed Turkish fixed-odds betting and horse-racing platform (Spor Toto Organization and United Racing contracts). Owned by Demirören group companies since a 2019 investment; the holding is private and unlisted, and no state or fund ownership of Misli itself was found - the Turkey Wealth Fund's gaming stakes are in other operators, not Misli. Right-sleeve sponsor of Galatasaray for 2025-26 through 2027-28.
